Bots now have one persistent conversation independent of project work. One mandatory Persistent Chat middleware owns routine, session, subscription and webhook management tools; source reports remain read/report-only.

Routines and sessions share typed lifecycle hooks, saved bindings and existing command handlers. Timers emit facts through that same path. Durable outbox/admission receipts, bounded causal ancestry, source revocation and recovery preserve delivery and authorization across restarts. New gateways default to Full Access; existing explicit settings are preserved.

Gateway protocol87, Bot SQLite5/catalog7 and ChatSpec15 require matching CLI0.16.0, desktop0.3.0 and iOS0.10.0. Existing state is converted separately while stopped; no runtime compatibility path is included.
